name: Samjin Eomuk Main Store (삼진어묵 본점)
notes: Korea's best-known fish-cake brand, run by the same family since 1953 (three generations) — this is the original Yeongdo store. There is a fish-cake making workshop on the 2nd floor. Parking available. ☎ 051-715-5865 · samjinfood.com

name: Brown Hands Baekje (브라운핸즈 백제)
notes: A cafe inside Busan's first modern Western-style hospital building, a registered cultural property; the interior deliberately preserves the age of the structure. Espresso and americano are the house drinks. The "1922" build date in earlier drafts is not in the official listing. ☎ 051-464-0332

name: Choryang Ondang (초량온당)
notes: Visit Busan: bakery; queues at opening; yellow-cheese bread is the listed favorite. Portal menu prices are not copied here. ☎ +82-507-1318-1271

name: Nampo Samgyetang (남포삼계탕)
notes: Visit Busan: more than 50 years; samgyetang with glutinous rice, ginseng, chestnut, jujube; electric grilled chicken also listed. Portal prices are not copied. ☎ +82-51-245-5075
hours: Mon–Fri 11:00–20:50 (break 15:30–16:30, last order 20:20). Sat–Sun 11:00–20:50 (last order 20:20). Closed traditional holidays.

name: Sungsimdang Main Store (성심당 본점)
notes: Founded 1956 near Daejeon Station selling steamed jjinbbang; today it bakes roughly 400 varieties. The two things to queue for are twigim soboro (deep-fried streusel bun) and the pantalong leek bread. Founding year is confirmed by the official listing; the "Daejeon's Taste #1" ranking in earlier drafts was not, and has been removed.

name: Lee Family's Tteokbokki (이가네 떡볶이)
notes: Visit Busan: the Bupyeong market tteokbokki stall made nationally famous by TV; the listed orders are a plain serving and a serving with twigim (fritters). Note it is a daytime stop — closes 17:00 and shuts Sundays, so it does not combine with the Bupyeong night market. ☎ 051-245-0413

name: A-Gate Cafe (에이게이트카페)
address: 183 Dongni 2-gil, Dongnam-gu (Mokcheon-eup) — Korean address as printed: 충청남도 천안시 동남구 동리2길 183
notes: Chungnam Tourism: large bakery café out at Mokcheon with a garden, terrace and a big car park behind; pets welcome. Listed dishes are a bagel-cream-cheese salad and a tomato-cheese oven pasta rather than only coffee. Sits between the Independence Hall of Korea and Yongyeon reservoir, so it is a drive-and-stop after the memorial rather than a city café. The portal leaves the closing-day field blank — call before going. ☎ 0507-1440-2207 · instagram.com/a_gate_cafe
hours: 10:00–22:00. Closing day not printed on the portal — confirm by phone.

name: bibibidang
notes: Visit Busan: traditional Korean teahouse using antique Goryeo celadon and Joseon white-porcelain teapots; matcha and pumpkin shaved ice are listed. No Korean name printed on the page. ☎ 051-746-0705

name: Bubu Coffee
notes: Visit Busan: small cafe run by a couple, roasting their own dark-roast specialty coffee. In Gwangbok-dong, walking distance from Jagalchi and BIFF Square — a useful daytime stop on the Nampo-dong loop. The official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ 010-7516-0484

name: Kervan Cafe (케르반 카페)
notes: VisitKorea (halal-friendly listing): Turkish cafe and bakery just off the Usadan-ro slope below Seoul Central Mosque. Turkish apple tea and Turkish coffee are the listed orders. Halal menu, alcohol-free, pork-free, Muslim chef, and a prayer room is available. 30 seats, no parking. ☎ +82-70-7532-1997 · turkishbakery.co.kr

name: Hyoja Bakery
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 3 Aug 2026): Seochon's first bakery, trading since 1987, next to Tongin Market below the old Blue House. Sweets, doughnuts, croquettes and the cornbread it is known for, alongside fermented breads and bagels. The listing warns it sells out at weekends and closes early when the bread runs out. The page also lists a dated summer break, "8/4~8/7", which has already passed. The official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-736-7629
hours: Tue–Sun 08:00–19:40, closing early when the bread runs out. Closed Mondays.

name: Cafe Layered Anguk Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 9 May 2026): the Anguk main store of Cafe Layered, in a hanok-roofed building 64m from Anguk Station Exit 2, known for lightly toasted scones — cranberry cream cheese and black sesame ang butter among them. Branch page — **this Anguk location only**. **No phone number is printed on the listing.** Instagram: @cafe_layered

name: Café Rosso
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 13 May 2026): a quiet cafe on the upper stretch of Samcheong-ro with a red sign, serving Brazil Fazenda drip coffee, cakes and a wine list. Anguk Station (Line 3) Exit 2, 974m — the far end of the Samcheong-dong walk. The official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1418-2622
hours: Mon–Tue 11:00–19:00; Wed–Sun 11:00–21:00. (No closing day printed on the listing.)

name: Avelop Hongdae Flagship
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 12 Sep 2025): bakery café in a 1972 Kim Chung-up house; bread baked daily and leftover discarded. Hongik Univ. Station Exit 1, 468 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-336-8897

name: Imi Coffee
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 12 May 2026): dessert-and-coffee pairing; reservations recommended. No phone is printed on the listing. Hongik Univ. Station Exit 1, 242 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. Instagram: @imi.coffee
hours: 12:00–21:00 (last order 20:30). Closed Tuesdays (Days of Operation: Wed–Mon).

name: Café Layered Yeonnam
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 22 May 2025): scones and cakes; 2F/3F window seats. Lot address as the portal prints it. Hongik Univ. Station Exit 3, 838 m. This Yeonnam location only (the Anguk branch is listed separately). Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1320-6219

name: EPI
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 4 Aug 2025): bakery café; baguettes, salted butter rolls, ciabatta. Seolleung Station Exit 8, 100 m. No closing day printed. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1308-3035
hours: 07:00–21:00 (no closing day printed on the listing)

notes: Visit Seoul (edited 22 May 2025): take-out only; salt bread baked six times a day (09:00 / 12:30 / 14:00 / 15:30 / 17:00 / 18:30). Seongsu Station Exit 3, 285 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-463-2245

hours: Sun–Thu 10:30–23:00 / Fri–Sat 10:30–24:00. Days of operation: Daily.

hours: Monday to Sunday 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30). Days of operation: Mon–Sun.

name: Scene
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 17 Jun 2025): large Seongsu café; 1F café, 2F select shop; pet-friendly. Seongsu Station Exit 4, 189 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1493-2127 · sceneseoul.com

name: CaféCité
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 11 Nov 2025): dessert café; Seongsu Brick Latte listed. Card payments only; pets on the outdoor terrace only. Seongsu Station Exit 3, 312 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-465-0811

name: Dotori Oven
notes: Visit Seoul (published & edited 26 Jun 2026): dessert café; oven-baked financiers and Greek yogurt. Seongsu Station Exit 4, 247 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1334-6058

hours: 11:00–18:00. Closed Mondays. Days of operation: Tuesday–Sunday.

hours: 10:00–19:00. Daily. Closed Lunar New Year & Chuseok.

name: Café SangGuk

hours: Mon–Sat 08:00–20:00 / Sun 08:00–19:00. Closed the day of Seollal and Chuseok.

name: Coffee Hanyakbang Hyehwa Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (published 19 Nov 2024, edited 12 May 2026): Hyehwa branch of the Euljiro coffee house; hand-drip filter coffee, milk teas and ades; desserts and bread from Hyemindang. This Hyehwa address only. Hyehwa Station Exit 2, 297 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-70-4200-4242
hours: Sun–Thu 12:00–21:00 / Fri–Sat 12:00–22:00 (last order 30 minutes before closing). Daily.

name: Cafe Highwaist Ikseon Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 9 May 2026): Ikseon-dong dessert cafe in a hanok; scones and cakes. This Ikseon address only. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 6, 119 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone. Menu prices are not copied.
hours: Daily 09:00–22:00. Open as usual on public holidays.

name: 1in1jan
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 29 May 2026): multi-floor cafe at Eunpyeong Hanok Village; drinks and desserts with Korean flavour. Hours differ by floor. Far north-west of the tourist core. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1487-1270
hours: 1F–2F 10:00–20:30 / 3F 10:00–19:00 (weekends 20:00) / 4F–6F 11:00–19:30. Closed Mondays (open as usual if Monday is a public holiday). Tue–Sun.

name: Piedra
notes: Visit Busan: Gwangalli dessert cafe; potato cake and orange shortcake are the printed signatures; tea by aroma; pets welcome. Geumnyeonsan Station Exit 5, 5-minute walk. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: M543 Cafe. Gallery
notes: Visit Busan: gallery cafe in Mandeok-dong; cafe and gallery on 2F, rooftop terrace on 3F; pets on the rooftop only. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-70-4225-5430

name: Café 385
notes: Visit Busan: four-floor ocean-view bakery cafe on Yeongdo; views of Oryukdo and Busandaegyo Bridge. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1431-0492

name: ORRD
notes: Visit Busan: four-floor garden cafe in Hakjang-dong with homemade sweets; dog-friendly ground floor and outdoor tables. Sasang-gu, west of the tourist core. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1374-8669

name: Café EL 16.52
notes: Visit Busan: seven-floor ocean-view bakery cafe in Songdo; wave-shaped architecture; roasting cafe on 3F; pets allowed on the rooftop. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1409-8881

name: Casa De Lux
notes: Visit Busan: media-art gallery cafe on Jeonpo Cafe Street; the body also spells it Casa De Luk. Jeonpo Station Exit 4, 1-minute walk. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1469-0598
